actual_root_cause: v2.0.0 DB migration added NOT NULL column tax_code without default; previous code cannot insert and rollback causes severe constraint failures
evaluator_notes: Rolling back v2.0.0->v1.1.0 is UNSAFE: v1.1.0 code does not include tax_code column in INSERT statements, which triggers NOT NULL violations on ALL new orders, worsening the outage. Correct action is degraded mode (use fallback tax handling) while a backward-compatible migration is deployed.
